root_cause_label: Hallucinated model name due to no network access
one_sentence_failure_summary: Unable to access the MTEB leaderboard due to missing network tools, the model hallucinated a fabricated model name ('DTU-Kilt/Matryoshka') instead of using the offline results repository approach to determine the correct answer.
t_err_evidence: At step 3, after two failed network attempts, the agent pivots to writing a hardcoded/heuristic model name to /app/result.txt without any actual leaderboard data; it writes 'KBLab/sentence-bert-swedish-cased' based on fabricated knowledge rather than finding the correct answer via the embeddings-benchmark/results repo.
t_commit_evidence: Step 3 writes an incorrect model name to /app/result.txt and subsequent steps (4-6) only change which fabricated name is written (to 'DTU-Kilt/Matryoshka') without ever accessing real leaderboard data, so the wrong-answer outcome is locked in at step 3.
t_surface_evidence: Step 4 reads /app/result.txt and shows 'KBLab/sentence-bert-swedish-cased', which is a visible signal that the answer is a heuristic guess rather than the correct leaderboard result (GritLM/GritLM-7B).
trigger_explanation: At step 3, after network tools fail, the agent acts on the false premise that its internal knowledge of Scandinavian embedding models is sufficient to determine the MTEB leaderboard winner as of August 2025, when in fact the correct approach requires consulting the actual embeddings-benchmark/results repository data.
forewarning_evidence: Step 1 shows 'curl: not found'; step 2 shows wget also fails with 'Failed to access leaderboard, researching alternative sources' — both signal that network-based retrieval of leaderboard data is impossible, yet the agent proceeds to fabricate an answer rather than trying the offline repository approach.
fabrication_evidence: Step 3 writes 'KBLab/sentence-bert-swedish-cased' as the best model based on a hardcoded list and internal knowledge; step 5 updates to 'DTU-Kilt/Matryoshka' described as having 'the highest Mean (Task) performance' — both are asserted without any actual leaderboard data. The correct answer per gold solution is 'GritLM/GritLM-7B'.
